checks.description: Frozen input identity: checkout HEAD equals the freeze record head, the freeze record manifest SHA-256 is 452528ae352cf14b415c3c4bd3b0b609151bf009949a1db91a508e78fb61f03d, and charter/DONE/slice-7.md SHA-256 equals dispatch.done_sha256 6fc7a2c5b198c4ab9ef13343385c938ea51d79f703e119094a36dd24cece20df.
Required toolchain: PATH included the Cargo bin directory; cargo --version reported 1.95.0 (f2d3ce0bd 2026-03-21). Cargo runs used distinct CARGO_TARGET_DIR values under /tmp/holden-mcp-codex7-*.

Host gate: cargo xtask gate slice-7 at the frozen HEAD on macOS/aarch64, with an isolated AGENT_PRIVATE_ROOT and the required read-only real-repo seed. Green. Formatting, Clippy, all 182 tests, replay of 37 records, verification of 12 ledgers, selftest (5/5 fail-without mutants caught), and all host guard checks passed. The test run record was saved under the isolated root.

Linux gate: the required perl alarm wrapper ran HOLDEN_VM_ADDR=192.168.64.10 cargo xtask gate slice-7 --linux-vm, with the isolated private root forwarded and the same seed staged on the VM. Linux/aarch64 gate result green_with_declared_limitations: 184 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored; formatting, Clippy, replay (37 records), ledger verification (12 ledgers), selftest (5/5 catches), and guest guard passed. Guest limitations were cargo_deny_absent, cargo_audit_absent, and charter_absent; the host gate covered those tools. The wrapper's raw-array comparison reports names/counts non-identical (182 host / 184 Linux); the separately reopened name sets match exactly the declared asymmetry in C10.

P1 reopened: installs_expected_files, no_sealed_bytes_in_host, and embed_is_idempotent passed in the host gate. In the scratch worktree, the sealed-plan-into-.holden mutant made tests::no_sealed_bytes_in_host RED; restoring the source made that exact test GREEN (1 passed).

P2 reopened: host_implementer_cannot_reveal passed in the host gate. In the scratch worktree, changing the embedded implementer server role mapping to evaluator made tests::host_implementer_cannot_reveal RED at the role assertion; restoring the source made that exact test GREEN (1 passed). Two preliminary role edits did not affect the embedded role map and were not counted as mutant evidence.

P3 reopened: post_commit_runs_jit_holdout and consecutive_commits_get_different_params passed in the full host gate. The latter test made two real commits and reopened the recorded runs. In the scratch worktree, a JIT trace mutant that reused the prior trace parameters for the same plan made tests::consecutive_commits_get_different_params RED at its parameter inequality assertion; restoring the source made that exact test GREEN (1 passed).

P4 reopened: agent_signed_approval_is_refused passed in the host gate and as a targeted test. A scratch mutant that accepted the approval's signer key made tests::agent_signed_approval_is_refused RED with 'an agent-signed approval was admitted'; restoring the source made it GREEN (1 passed). An independent Rust verifier read only the published owner.pub and the four public demo approval JSON files; all 4/4 Ed25519 signatures verified over the domain, cognition ID, and promise ID. No private key was read or used.

P5 reopened: sealed_read_is_denied and block_reachable_when_bounds_met passed in the host gate and as targeted tests. In the scratch worktree, removing the macOS product read denial and parent-read self-check denial made both named tests RED; restoring the profile made sealed_read_is_denied GREEN (1 passed) and block_reachable_when_bounds_met GREEN (1 passed).

Declared host/VM test-name asymmetry verified from both gate run records, with status suffixes removed: host-only exactly holden-cli::tests::readme_quickstart_leads_to_green_check; Linux-only exactly holden-embed::tests::non_tty_caller_cannot_approve, holden-seal::linux::tests::sealed_roundtrip_uses_argon2id_and_xchacha20poly1305, and holden-seal::linux::tests::unseal_requires_interactive_tty. No other names differed.

Reopen attestation independently verified: charter.reopen/1 binds slice-7, HEAD 376599def3b19f4ac7d24e13f56fc3eb6e98ff0c, manifest SHA-256 452528ae352cf14b415c3c4bd3b0b609151bf009949a1db91a508e78fb61f03d, and the unchanged pinned DONE hash; all proofs 1-5 reference evidence SHA-256 abc115af1ff331f551b0d7c0394dc0ac47490d5149dd37142e50f14b690a3ea9. The evidence file hashes to that value and contains the two named gate records; both record commit 376599def3b19f4ac7d24e13f56fc3eb6e98ff0c with results green and green_with_declared_limitations. D1 is closed.
